rules.name: rrr-fn-rows-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT trade_id, derivative_type, product_code, CAST(active_lots AS numeric(30, 8)) AS active_lots, CAST(settle_price AS numeric(30, 10)) AS settle_price, CAST(mult_factor AS numeric(30, 10)) AS mult_factor, CAST(nc_factor AS numeric(30, 10)) AS nc_factor, CAST(fx_nc_factor AS numeric(30, 10)) AS fx_nc_factor, CAST(mkt_value_usd AS numeric(30, 4)) AS mkt_value_usd, CAST(mtm_usd AS numeric(30, 4)) AS mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND value_date = :valueDate AND contract_number IS NOT NULL AND upper(split_part(contract_number, '_', 1)) IN ('AST', 'BFA', 'BFE', 'BOV', 'LIB', 'IOL')

SELECT p.trade_id, p.derivative_type, p.product_code, CAST(p.active_lots AS numeric(30, 8)) AS active_lots, CAST(p.settle_price AS numeric(30, 10)) AS settle_price, CAST(p.mult_factor AS numeric(30, 10)) AS mult_factor, CAST(p.nc_factor AS numeric(30, 10)) AS nc_factor, CAST(p.fx_nc_factor AS numeric(30, 10)) AS fx_nc_factor, CAST(p.mkt_value_usd AS numeric(30, 4)) AS mkt_value_usd, CAST(p.mtm_usd AS numeric(30, 4)) AS mtm_usd FROM opera.fn_client_statement_position_rows_v2( (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1), CAST(:bu AS text), CAST(:valueDate AS date), CAST('["AST","BFA","BFE","BOV","LIB","IOL"]' AS jsonb)) p
